title: Wix: The Internet Storefront - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 10]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we will be breaking down Wix.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we will be breaking down Wix. Founded in 2006, Wix was created to make building websites easier. In this breakdown, we will explore how the company helped to lay the rails for small businesses to get on the internet.

key_points.text: We cover the development strategies that linked Wix to the creator economy.
We touch on the evolution of the freemium business model, and we analyze what differentiates Wix as a one-stop-shop from an increasingly competitive market.
For this episode, I am joined by Dave Ambrose.
